AWS (manual, reviewed)
Operator runs cdk diff, reviews it, then cdk deploy. The GitHub OIDC deploy role is blocked by an AWS Organizations policy, so the deploy workflow cannot run.

div.div: Validated: image v14 on AWS us-east-2 — live suite 24 of 24 checks, 4 of 4 X-Ray traces, Fargate ingestion matching committed evidence. Torn down on 2026-11-06 to remove charges; checks found no remaining stack, bucket, repository, user pool, database, snapshot, load balancer or log group. Always available at no cost: GitHub, GitHub Pages and both Vercel sites. Reprovisioning follows docs/runbooks/deployment.md and requires Manisha's authorization; the CDK pins Region us-east-2 and in-region Bedrock models only. Cost: an 8-hour demonstration is estimated at $2.95 of fixed charges and about $60.80 per month if left running (reports/cost).
